card.name: Partway through odd or split words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle or end of a word that is split up, such as 'se' after 'per', the 'B' in EXACERBATION, or 'ans' in slogans. It also fires on a few non-Latin script letters.

modes.label: Latin 'per se'
modes.description: The second part of 'per se' or 'per say' after 'per'.
modes.example: Not a Federal employment discrimination law per<< se>>.

modes.label: Split uncommon words
modes.description: A middle or end piece of a rarer word broken into parts, such as EXACERBATION, slogans or affidavits.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B
